turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
I’m sorry your print hasn’t arrived. Could you send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check the delivery status.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I’m sorry your print still hasn’t arrived. I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague who will take over. Please share your order number and the email address you used at checkout so they can look into the delivery.

input.summary: Customer reports their print has not arrived and says they will file an ANPC complaint today, contact their bank for a chargeback, and leave a public review. Order number and checkout email were requested but not provided. Obtain both to verify and investigate delivery.
